summary.text: Shanna Cox is the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her Ballotpedia survey response describes her as a community and economic development leader and small business owner in Lewiston.

paragraphs.text: Shanna Cox earned a high school diploma from George Stevens Academy and a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine in 2015.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as business owner and president.
Her survey response says she became a single parent of three young children at 29 and relied on programs such as MaineCare and Head Start while building her career.
Her survey response lists affordability, housing and healthcare among her key campaign messages.
On housing, the response says Lewiston has made progress in recent years and that policy should sustain what is working while addressing what comes next.
